description:
• Brand introduction: ConnexCard is a cutting-edge solution for modern networking, offering smart business cards that leverage NFC technology to share contact information instantly and efficiently. Our mission is to revolutionize the way professionals connect and manage their networks, providing eco-friendly, cost-effective, and technologically advanced alternatives to traditional business cards.

• Product description:
ConnexCard offers a range of smart business cards and related products designed to streamline networking and enhance professional interactions. Our products include the standard Connex Card, customizable Connex Cards, Connex Metal Cards, and Connex Tags. Each product allows users to share their contact details, social media profiles, and other important information with a simple tap, making networking seamless and efficient. The cards are made from durable materials and are available in various styles and finishes, including plastic, premium metal, and holographic designs.
 
• USP (Unique Selling Point): ConnexCard's unique selling points include:

  • Unlimited Sharing: Share your profile as much as you like without ever running out of business cards.
  • Eco-Friendly: Reduce waste and save money compared to traditional printed cards.
  • Customization: Design a profile that reflects your brand identity, complete with links to your website and social media.
  • Real-Time Updates: Instantly update your contact details and profile information in real-time, ensuring your network always has the latest information.
  • Smart Networking: Instantly share your profile and contact details with NFC technology.
  • Bilingual Availability: Available in both English and French to cater to a wider audience.
  • Analytics: Easily monitor and analyze your networking efforts to improve outreach and track performance.


• Payment terms:

  • Commission Rate: 30% per sale
  • Cookie Duration: 30 days
  • Payout Frequency: Monthly
  • Payout Method: Paypal

 
• Other information:

  • No Subscription Required: Personal accounts are free, and a subscription is only required for team management features & Pro version.
  • Secure Information: We prioritize the security of our users' information, ensuring all data shared is protected and used responsibly.
  • Customer Support: Dedicated support is available via email at support@connexcard.com, and tutorials can be found on our YouTube channel.
